description.en-US: Newman's nine discourses on university education, delivered in Dublin in 1852 for the new Catholic University of Ireland: theology as a branch of knowledge, knowledge as its own end, liberal education and the duties of the Church toward knowledge. Ten occasional essays on university subjects (1858) follow: Christianity and letters, literature, elementary studies, physical science, university preaching, and discipline of mind.
description.pt-BR: Os nove discursos de Newman sobre a educação universitária, proferidos em Dublin em 1852 para a nova Universidade Católica da Irlanda: a teologia como ramo do saber, o saber como fim em si mesmo, a educação liberal e os deveres da Igreja para com o saber. Seguem-se dez ensaios sobre temas universitários (1858): cristianismo e letras, literatura, estudos elementares, ciência física, pregação universitária e disciplina da mente.

en-US.editor: John Henry Newman (uniform edition of 1873; Newman Reader)

sources.edition: The Idea of a University defined and illustrated (London: Longmans, Green, 1873 edition and later impressions), as transcribed by the Newman Reader.
sources.description: 20 chapters: Newman Reader page numbers, navigation and its editorial remarks are dropped; Newman's own notes are kept as footnotes.  Raw page text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain: Newman died in 1890 and the text is of a Longmans impression (or earlier edition) before 1930. The Newman Reader page footers claim copyright in the site's transcription (c) 2007 NINS; a plain transcription of a public-domain text adds no authorship under US law.
